title: Returns and refunds
text: Unopened items may be returned within 30 days of delivery. Report damaged items within 7 days of delivery. Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5–10 business days after inspection. This demo cannot approve or issue refunds.

title: Shipping and delivery
text: Standard shipping takes 3–5 business days after dispatch. Processing may take up to 2 business days before dispatch. These are general estimates, not a guaranteed arrival date for an individual order.

title: Cancellations and address changes
text: Cancellation or shipping address change requests can be reviewed only before dispatch. Shipped orders cannot be cancelled or rerouted through this store. Contact a support representative to request review. AI chat cannot change or cancel orders. The local review sandbox can record a manual approval and cancel a fictional processing order.
